# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 3: Condottieri Contracts, Free Company Mutiny Disaster & Gunpowder Logistics Reform (oe_mer2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_mercenaries.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Demobilize & Settle Free Companies (5-year cooldown; lowers arrears risk by 35 and settles border veterans)
oe_mer2_dec_demobilize_free_companies = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			oe_mer2_risk_at_least_15 = yes
			has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_mer2_free_company_mutiny
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mer2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		gold >= 120
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mer2_demobilize_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_mer2_demobilize_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:peasants } }
	option = {
		name = oe_mer2_dec_demobilize_free_companies.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_mer2_dec_demobilize_free_companies.a.tt
			change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -3.5 min = 100 max = 1000 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_demobilize_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			oe_mer2_add_arrears_risk = { AMOUNT = -35 }
			oe_mer2_settle_border_veterans = yes
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mer2.8
		}
	}
}

# 2. Establish Royal State Cannon Foundry (Age 3+, one-time permanent artillery reform + market demand bridge)
oe_mer2_dec_artillery_standardization = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		current_year >= 1437
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_royal_cannon_foundry }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mer2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 300
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mer2_mil_50_tt
			oe_mer2_has_mil_50_leadership = yes
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:burghers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_mer2_dec_artillery_standardization.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_mer2_dec_artillery_standardization.a.tt
			change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -5.0 min = 250 max = 1200 }
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_mer2_royal_cannon_foundry
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
			oe_mer2_inject_capital_demand = { DEMAND = oe_mer2_cannon_foundry_demand YEARS = 4 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mer2.9
		}
	}
}

# 3. Abolish Condottieri & Charter Standing Army (Age 4+, one-time reform granting permanent mutiny immunity)
oe_mer2_dec_abolish_condottieri_system = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		current_year >= 1537
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_standing_army_reformed }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mer2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 400
		stability >= 15
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mer2_no_mutiny_or_low_risk_tt
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_mer2_free_company_mutiny }
				oe_mer2_risk_at_most_20 = yes
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_mer2_dec_abolish_condottieri_system.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_mer2_dec_abolish_condottieri_system.a.tt
			change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -6.0 min = 350 max = 1600 }
			oe_mer2_clear_regional_charters = yes
			set_variable = { name = oe_mer2_arrears_risk value = 0 }
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_mer2_standing_army_reformed
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
			oe_mer2_inject_capital_demand = { DEMAND = oe_mer2_standing_army_ordnance_demand YEARS = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mer2.10
		}
	}
}
